title: Snapshot exceeds its managed heap limit
root_cause: The workflow sets a 32 MiB managed heap limit while the snapshot retains 100 one-megabyte arrays. The process runs out of memory; it needs a larger heap or a smaller working set.

relevant_evidence.why: The step sets the heap limit and reports out of memory.
The job sets the managed heap limit for the process.
The program retains roughly 100 MiB of arrays.
